lead_raw_text:
The CeY₂ phase crystallizes in the trigonal space group R-3 (No. 143), with a 9-atom unit cell (Ce₃Y₆) and two independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis gives both Ce and Y centers 12 geometric neighbors in a close-packed-like local arrangement, with Ce surrounded by 12 Y neighbors and Y by 4 Ce and 8 Y neighbors, over distances of 3.5256–3.563 Å. The geometric neighbor graph is three-dimensional and connected across all 9 sites. Validated polyhedron contacts show Y–Y 12-vertex polyhedra sharing corners, edges, and faces, while Ce–Y pairs share corners and edges.
